title: RunRequest
description: Body of POST /goose/run (hub), POST /run (runner, internal) and POST /api/run (Vercel fallback).

code.description: Goose source of a single root file. At most 65536 UTF-8 bytes; the byte limit is enforced by the server.

turnstileToken.description: Cloudflare Turnstile response token. Ignored by the runner. Required by the hub and the fallback once Turnstile is enabled.
